title: It leaked
text: It leaked. I really loved how it worked for the first 2 weeks. Then I noticed the water level dissipated quicker than prior use, it was leaking. I never went above max water level, it was on a level surface and in an area no one could bump it. Now I just use it as a fan

UILTRA-QUIET OPERATION: This portable air fan can work powerfully at a low noise level. Under the quite work mode, the quality of air cooling is still unaffected. This ultra-quiet air cooler make you enjoy a comfortable sleep all night with suitable temperature and low-level noise.
